Slot Insulation Paper Manufacturer in India

Class E Fish Paper for Slot, Phase & Turn-to-Turn Insulation

Harnawa Insulations is a recognized manufacturer of Slot Insulation Paper in India offering good quality laminated insulation paper which is also referred to as Fish Paper. Our Slot Insulation Paper belongs to our  (https://harnawainc.com/laminated-insulation-paper-composites/) Laminated Insulation Paper Composites category and consists of the electrical characteristics of the press paper along with the mechanical characteristics of the polyester film.

Product Overview

Slot Insulation Paper is made up of two-layer laminated sheets, which include a combination of 100% sulfate wood pulp presspaper and PET polyester film using B-class Adhesive. The paper provides fiber strength and flexibility, whereas the polyester film helps increase the dielectric strength, smoothness of the surface, and water resistance properties of the material, making it flexible even at lower temperatures.
